tools.name: get_conversion_example
tools.description: Return a complete example input for optimize_roth_conversions with a one-line explanation of every field. No solve. Edit it to the user's situation. kind 'single' (default: a 60-year-old early retiree with a traditional IRA, a brokerage account and Social Security later) or 'married'.

tools.name: optimize_roth_conversions
tools.description: Find the best Roth conversion amount for each year of a retirement plan, with living expenses funded from the right accounts and tax paid each year. Returns per-year conversions, taxes and balances, the after-tax wealth at the end with vs without conversions, totals, a plain-language plan narrative

tools.name: check_request
tools.description: Say in plain words what the user wants (e.g. 'I'm still working and want to know Roth vs traditional 401k'). Returns whether this optimizer can do it and, if not, the closest thing it can do (or the sister server that can). Fast, no solve.
